headline.purpose: Venture title and first-run heading; one per page.

title.purpose: Top bar page title and section heads.

body.purpose: All running text, rail items, table cells, buttons at 500.

label.purpose: Field labels and rail headings; at 400 for metadata and pills.

data.purpose: Monospace for seq, slugs, dates and versions only.

shadows.name: field-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs, textareas, selects, the slug field and the thread composer (with an ember border).

shadows.name: node-gap
shadows.purpose: Cuts the spine line around each node.

shadows.name: hollow-marker
shadows.purpose: Hollow pixel and node markers (settled, loose, goal).

shadows.name: checked-segment
shadows.purpose: The checked option of the segmented control; the only lift.

shadows.name: topbar-glass
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: blur(8px) over color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground) 92%, transparent)

shadows.name: work-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on a work tree row or thread list row; square, replaces the focus ring.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Background, border and color transitions on controls and rail; table rows 100ms.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 220ms (200ms for inline forms), opacity 0 and translateY(-4px) in
motion.purpose: Reason row, settle panel and inline add forms opening.

motion.name: simmer
motion.value: 1.8s; pixel from translateY(3px) scale(1.6) in ember light, node from translateY(4px) scale(1.8)
motion.purpose: A live change arriving: the touched node and its rail pixel pulse once.

motion.name: row-simmer
motion.purpose: Fresh row background flash; also the Work goal outcome reached by link.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Reconnect pixel while the live stream is down, in the rail foot and in a thread's stream-down line.

motion.name: working
motion.purpose: Agent run live: live pixels (rail, thread list, work pane), live author marks, pending tool markers and the streaming caret. Only while a run is active.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes simmer, flash, reveal, shimmer, blink, the work add-form reveal, the target-goal flash, the working pulse (live pixels, live author marks, pending tool markers, streaming caret), the thread stream-down blink, and the strategy, fold and tool chevron rotations

breakpoints.name: compact-work
breakpoints.value: max-width: 1279px (work pane 320px, main padding 24px, keyboard hint hidden with the pane open)

narrative.overview:
A working console for one expert owner steering several ventures. A committed charcoal rail (Slack's posture) sits beside a Linear-precise work area on a barely-cream ground. Everything reads top-down along one connected line, the spine: strategy kernel, then bets, then the goals testing them. Density is high and quiet: 13px system UI, hairline rules, 28px controls, no decoration that does not carry state.

The brand's simmering-terminal logo supplies exactly two devices and no more: the pixel-square bubble, which becomes every status and activity marker, and the ember orange, which is reserved for the one thing that matters on a screen. The app must never read as terminal cosplay or kitchen kitsch; monospace appears only where the content is literally data.

Liveness is shown, never claimed. Changes that arrive from elsewhere make the touched node and its rail square simmer once (an ember pulse that settles), and a blinking pixel appears in the rail foot only while the live stream is down.

Agent work is shown the same way. While Claude is running, its pixel pulses (the working pulse) in the rail, the thread list and the conversation, and its tool calls fold into quiet one-line rounds; when the run ends, everything settles back to neutral.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal rail (232px) + cream work area; desktop only (1024px minimum width).
Hairline-ruled rows and definition grids instead of cards.
Pixel-square markers (5-7px, square, never round) for every status.
Ember on the primary action, selection and live state only.
Monospace strictly for data: seq numbers, slugs, dates, versions.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks the primary action, the current selection, or live state. Nothing else. One ember button per view section; never on headings, icons, links or decoration.

rules.name: The Quiet Default Rule
rules.body: Resting UI is neutral. Ember appears on a pixel only when it means "active now" or "just changed"; otherwise the pixel is Line Strong, Ink 3 or the quiet rail grey.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for machine values: seq, slugs, dates, versions. Never for headings, labels, buttons or prose. If a human wrote it, it is sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Numeric table columns are right-aligned with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No Cards Rule
rules.body: Content never sits in shadowed, bordered tiles. Group with hairline rules, definition grids and sunk-ground regions. The single bordered box is the transient add-bet form (10px radius) while it is open.

dos: **Do** keep ember (#ec693a) to the primary action, the current selection and live state; one primary button per section.
**Do** mark every status and activity with a square pixel (5-7px), filled or hollow (1.5px inset), never a dot or icon.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines (#e9e4d8) and sunk ground (#f5f1e8) instead of containers.
**Do** set seq numbers, slugs, dates and versions in monospace at 12px with tabular numerals, and nothing else.
**Do** hang new strategy-derived content off the spine: kernel, bets, goals, top-down on one line.
**Do** show liveness with the 1.8s simmer on what changed, and the reconnect pixel only while the stream is down.
**Do** keep work markers neutral: ember fills a work marker only while the item is doing.
**Do** honor reduced motion by removing every animation listed under States.

**Do** show agent work live with the 1.6s working pulse, and only while a run is active; when it ends the thread pixel returns to Line Strong and the author mark to ink. Ember stays for the primary action, selection and live state.
donts: **Don't** wrap content in cards, tiles or kanban columns; the only bordered box is the transient add-bet form.
**Don't** use ember for headings, links, icons, borders at rest or decoration.
**Don't** use monospace for prose, labels or headings; no terminal cosplay or kitchen kitsch.
**Don't** add shadows for elevation; the focus ring, field halo, node gap and checked segment are the whole vocabulary.
**Don't** add round status dots; markers are square.
**Don't** go above 20px type or add a display face.
